code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_seps = {r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg}
    col_seps = {c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != bg}

    def spans(n, separators):
        out, start = [], 0
        for i in sorted(separators):
            if start < i:
                out.append((start, i))
            start = i + 1
        if start < n:
            out.append((start, n))
        return out

    row_spans, col_spans = spans(h, row_seps), spans(w, col_seps)
    panels = [(r0, r1, c0, c1) for r0, r1 in row_spans for c0, c1 in col_spans]
    source = max(panels, key=lambda p: sum(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(p[0], p[1]) for c in range(p[2], p[3])))
    r0, r1, c0, c1 = source
    ph, pw = r1-r0, c1-c0
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for a, b, x, y in panels:
        for r in range(a, b):
            for c in range(x, y):
                out[r][c] = grid[r0+(r-a)%ph][c0+(c-x)%pw]
    return out
'''
